title: Concept: Service worker registered at the root scope
description: A service worker registration that claims the root scope in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: A root-scoped worker intercepts every request the origin makes, so a compromised worker sees all traffic, including authenticated API calls, and can persist after the tab closes.
applicability: Progressive web apps and offline statement viewers.
risk: One worker bug or injection gives an attacker a persistent position over every request in the origin.
